title: Align addressing spec human IID derivation with canonical SHA-512 native model
description: spec/03-addressing.md normatively says SHA-256(pubkey), and claims the IID is used for ULA/optional GUA, while canonical implementations/vectors/security spec use SHA-512(pubkey)[0:8] with U/L clear, link-local plus exact 0200::/8 native /128, no ULA. Correct the normative derivation and cross-references to eliminate an implementation-splitting contradiction.
